reader.requirement: At COBOL-85 a USAGE clause ([USAGE IS] DISPLAY) may be written in any report group description entry - format 1 (level 01), format 2 (LINE/group) and format 3 (elementary printable) entries, in every TYPE of group - and must be accepted there (subject only to the separate SR3 and §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR8 restrictions).

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 runs ScreenReportEntryFormats, the 1985 entry-format screens incl. SR8 (USAGE only on/above printable items)
national data / N picture / national literal refused at 85 (COBOL0900), so only DISPLAY survives in a report entry

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 only DISPLAY exists and the 1985 format/SR8 screens apply; 2002+ also admits NATIONAL; the admission of the clause on every entry is the same grammar alternative
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f10_02 covers USAGE on a DE 01 entry, a LINE group entry and COLUMN entries; not PH/CF groups, the bare DISPLAY form without the USAGE keyword, signed SEPARATE or SUM items

probes.expected: USAGE (with and without the USAGE IS words) on 01 PH, DE, CF entries, a LINE group entry and elementary items incl. SIGN LEADING/TRAILING SEPARATE, numeric edited and SUM: all accepted and printed as derived

probes.printed: COBOL2198 on USAGE COMP; COBOL0900 national data/N literal requires COBOL-2002
probes.expected: non-DISPLAY usage refused (SR3) and the 2002 NATIONAL form refused at 85

citations.check: OK  §1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR1  (3.21.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: The grammar admits usageClause in every reportGroupClause list; DescribeReportItem captures it on every entry and only SR3 (ScreenReportUsage) and the 1985 SR8 screen refuse. Class e/f probes do not apply to a permissive declaration rule.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.3.21 and §1985:XIII.3.9 (formats 1-3 all carry [[USAGE IS] DISPLAY]; SR6 'A format 2 entry must contain at least one optional clause', so a format 2 entry whose only clause is USAGE is legal). Probe refute-1985-212/src/us_more.cob at --std 85, aimed at forms the reader did not try: RH and RF groups with USAGE on 01; a format 2 entry with USAGE alone ('02 USAGE IS DISPLAY.') and one with a data-name and bare DISPLAY ('02 GRP2 DISPLAY.'); USAGE beside JUST RIGHT, GROUP INDICATE, BLANK WHEN ZERO, SUM+SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE, and a format 3 entry carrying its own LINE. EXIT 0, report printed RH / '  XYZ' / 'XYZ' (BWZ zero blank) / '07-' / RF. The reader's us_national_comp covers the later-edition NATIONAL refusal. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR1  (3.21.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.9.3 SR6  (3.9.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR6'.
